The '''Assault on Liintaar''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Liintaar Station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The assault was used as a gameplay example in ''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]'', with the suggestion that [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s took part in the battle.
